fixture_reviews.rationale: The source should be surfaced because it presents a legal-value constraint on an architectural field, but the legal set is the fixed singleton {0}. It therefore leaves no implementation choice and is correctly classified out without producing a final parameter.

The statement should be surfaced because it explicitly depends on whether Svpbmt is implemented. Under the approved PBMTE ontology policy, this is extension-gating evidence rather than an independent final implementation parameter, so surfaced then classified out is the correct disposition.
The relevant CSR address bits encode access properties fixed by the ISA. They do not expose an implementation-selectable parameter, so the fixture is correctly treated as a non-surfaced negative.

The cited statement requires the relevant cache-block size to be uniform throughout the system. This is a consistency constraint and does not itself introduce an implementation choice; the implementation-specific size is represented separately by the positive cache-block fixture.
The source is software or compiler guidance and explicitly does not define a RISC-V architectural parameter. It is therefore correctly excluded from discovery.

The specification permits an implementation-dependent distinction in whether mtvec contains a read-only value or is writable. This is a genuine implementation choice and correctly supports the MTVEC access parameter.

The source explicitly identifies the cache-block size as implementation-specific. Under the approved unified-cache-block ontology policy, it correctly yields one CACHE_BLOCK_SIZE identity rather than separate management, prefetch, and zero-block identities.

The implementation may provide zero, sixteen, or sixty-four PMP entries. This is an explicit finite implementation choice and correctly supports NUM_PMP_ENTRIES with the frozen legal domain {0, 16, 64}.

GEILEN records an implementation-supported guest-external-interrupt count and may validly be zero. The fixture correctly treats it as a positive parameter while preserving the frozen GEILEN canonical interpretation and its existing ontology alias mapping.
The implemented ASID width is explicitly implementation-defined. The fixture correctly extracts this choice using ASIDLEN as the canonical ontology identity.

The set of legal mtvec.MODE values may vary by implementation. This is a genuine implementation-dependent legal-value set and is correctly accepted as the MTVEC_MODES parameter under the frozen contract.

semantic_responses.rationale: Two valid half-open evidence spans that touch at one boundary remain distinct semantic occurrences. Adjacency alone does not erase provenance, multiplicity, or score-bearing identity, so merging, trimming, coalescing, or dropping either span is forbidden.

The three encodings have different typed meanings. A canonical no-finding uses surfaced=false, null parameter fields, and evidence_spans=[]; null is not a valid evidence array, while [x] represents exactly one evidence occurrence.

Evidence occurrences that compare equal on their semantic fields must retain both multiplicity and original input order. Using the input ordinal as the final tie-break prevents unstable set conversion, silent deduplication, and nondeterministic hashes.

An unresolved review status is not a successful formal disposition and must not enter completed metrics. The two frozen candidates are no longer unresolved: both are explicitly surfaced and classified out under the approved PBMTE and fixed-legal-set policies, without creating final parameter identities.

Adjacency after deterministic diagnostic sorting is only a presentation relationship. Every diagnostic occurrence must remain independently present and ordered; adjacent diagnostics must not be coalesced or reduced to the first occurrence.

Diagnostic collections must always be arrays. [] means no diagnostics, null is structurally invalid, and [x] means exactly one retained diagnostic whose severity determines whether execution is blocked or completes with an allowlisted warning.

Diagnostics must be ordered by the complete deterministic key, with original input ordinal used only as the final tie-break. Equal early sort fields must not cause unstable reordering or loss of occurrence multiplicity through deduplication.
